properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.pagination.enabled
properties.description: Whether Coco registers the default MyBatis-Plus pagination inner interceptor.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.pagination.db-type
properties.description: Database type used by the pagination inner interceptor. Leave empty to let MyBatis-Plus infer it from the current data source.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.pagination.overflow
properties.description: Whether an overflow page number should fall back to the first page.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.pagination.max-limit
properties.description: Maximum page size allowed by the pagination inner interceptor. Empty or non-positive values mean unlimited.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.pagination.optimize-join
properties.description: Whether the pagination count SQL should optimize join clauses.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.sql-guard.block-attack-enabled
properties.description: Whether Coco registers the MyBatis-Plus block attack inner interceptor to prevent full-table update and delete statements.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.sql-guard.illegal-sql-enabled
properties.description: Whether Coco registers the MyBatis-Plus illegal SQL inner interceptor.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.datasource.enabled
properties.description: Whether Coco enables the dynamic multi-datasource routing auto-configuration.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.datasource.primary
properties.description: Default primary datasource name used when no routing key is present in context.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.datasource.missing-policy
properties.description: Policy applied when a requested datasource name or group is not registered.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.datasource.transaction-policy
properties.description: Policy applied when switching to a different datasource inside an active local Spring transaction.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.datasource.load-balance-strategy
properties.description: Load balancing strategy used when routing to a datasource group.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.datasource.group-separator
properties.description: Delimiter used to automatically infer a datasource group from a datasource name prefix (for example 'slave_1' -> 'slave').

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.datasource.aspect-order
properties.description: Order of the @CocoDataSource routing aspect advisor. Defaults to running before @Transactional.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.datasource.max-key-length
properties.description: Maximum allowed length of a resolved datasource routing key.

properties.name: coco.mybatis-plus.datasource.sources
properties.description: Declarative map of named datasource definitions managed by CocoRoutingDataSource.
